text:
joni: Heads up — after tonight's cuda-driver 535.104 rollout in eu-west-1, ~120 GPU nodes report MIG profiles removed and device UUIDs remapped. Scheduler is failing pods that require mig profiles.

mike: Any pattern? kernel bump too? release notes mentioned some MIG rework.

sara: deploy-bot shows driver rollout at 23:42 UTC to eu-west-1 pool-a. id: deploy/driver/2026-03-17-2342

deploy-bot: Deployment complete: driver-upgrade eu-west-1 pool-a to nvidia-driver 535.104 (canary->rollout).

ivan: Can you paste nvidia-smi output from one affected node?

joni: `nvidia-smi -L` on node gpu-eu-127 shows GPUs but `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=gpu_uuid` returns UUIDs that don't match MIG profile metadata. `nvidia-smi mig -L` returns nothing.

li-chen: That node also pulled kernel 6.1.12 from imaging during reboot window. We bumped kernel in same window for a CVE.

mike: Likely kernel+driver ordering caused NVML to re-enumerate devices and change devpath/UUID mapping.

sara: Pods with nodeSelector `feature=gpu-mig` are getting evicted. Autoscaler is spinning up replacement nodes which come up with older driver, so capacity dip.

joni: Quick checks: `journalctl -u nvidia-drm | grep -i mig` and `dmesg | grep -i nvidia` — on affected nodes I see 'MIG profile restore failed' and 'NVML MIG profile not found for UUID xxxxx'.

ivan: We have a migration cache in /var/lib/mig-profiles/* — could be cleared on imaging. If cache stale, manifests won't match.

mike: We can recreate profiles with `sudo nvidia-smi mig -i 0 -cgi <profile-spec> -C` but that may disrupt live pods. Need careful plan.

joni: Kernel-assigned pci addresses shifted so our nv-hostlabel -> k8s label mapping is wrong: labels still point to old UUIDs.

li-chen: Proposal: pause rollout. Can infra ops rollback driver package in pool-a to 530.86? That was known-good.

sara: Pausing remaining batches now. @mike can you own remediation for impacted nodes?

mike: Plan: 1) cordon affected nodes; 2) drain non-critical GPU pods; 3) run `nvidia-smi -pm 1; nvidia-smi -mig reset -y` then reapply profiles from golden manifest `/etc/mig-manifests/eu-west1/pool-a/*.json` using `nvidia-mig-manager apply --manifest`; 4) verify `nvidia-smi mig -L` and node labels; 5) uncordon.

ivan: Note: `nvidia-mig-manager` isn't present on images older than 2026-01; fallback is our nvml python script. Also ensure `/etc/mig-manifests` sync via gitops.

joni: I tried applying manifest on gpu-eu-127 and got `error: uuid mismatch - expected 2234-..., found 7a12-...`. Manifest uses old UUIDs — changed after reboot.

mike: If UUIDs changed we should match by pci.bus_id instead of persisted UUIDs. Update reconciler to map by pci bus and rewrite manifests with current UUIDs.

li-chen: Immediate mitigation: can we patch k8s scheduler to tolerate MIGless nodes for critical workloads temporarily?

sara: I'll coordinate with platform-sre to allow tolerations for critical jobs for max 4 hours and notify customers.

mike: I'll prepare a script to reconcile manifests by scanning `nvidia-smi -q -x` and rewriting uuid fields for affected pool. Need approval to run across ~120 nodes.

joni: Approved. Start with 5 canary nodes. Runbook: 1) fetch `nvidia-smi -q -x`, 2) map profiles to pci ids, 3) generate new manifest, 4) apply via `nvidia-mig-manager apply`, 5) verify `nvidia-smi mig -L` matches manifest.

deploy-bot: Incident tracker created: INC-2026-0359. PagerDuty: infra-oncall.

ivan: Log bundle prepared for NVIDIA: /var/log/nvidia-bundles/eu-west-1/pool-a-20260317.tar.gz (includes nv-hostlabel mapping + udev events). I'll file vendor ticket.

mike: Starting canary on gpu-eu-127 and gpu-eu-131, will post progress.

joni: 23:58 update: applied manifest to gpu-eu-127, `nvidia-smi mig -L` now shows profiles restored, pods rescheduled. 7 other nodes failed due to read-only /var/lib/mig-profiles during apply.

sara: Rollout paused and customers notified for 30m. Sales + customer success alerted for impacted capacity.

li-chen: Action items: mike - reconciler canary (assigned); ivan - collect logs + vendor ticket; sara - pause rollout + customer comms; joni - update runbook. Target: full remediation in 6h or rollback driver.

mike: Will post canary results in 15m.
